task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the Master_Service_Agreement_Template.txt file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the content of ~/Documents/Master_Service_Agreement_Template.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Print Templates section in Vtiger settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Vtiger CRM interface showing the 'Print Templates' list or creation screen.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a new template named 'MSA Contract' assigned to the Quotes module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The template creation form with 'MSA Contract' in the name field and 'Quotes' selected as the module.

task_completion.description: Agent pastes the text and maps [ORGANIZATION NAME], [QUOTE NUMBER], and [GRAND TOTAL] to Vtiger merge fields.

task_completion.description: Agent locates and selects the quote 'Q-Enterprise Server Deployment'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Quotes module list view or detail view showing 'Q-Enterprise Server Deployment' selected.

task_completion.description: Agent uses the 'MSA Contract' template to generate a PDF and saves it to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal showing 'Enterprise_MSA.pdf' exists in ~/Documents, or a 'Save As' dialog pointing to that path.

integrity.description: The agent must use the Vtiger web interface to create the template, not just SQL commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the browser interacting with the Vtiger Print Template editor.

integrity.description: The agent should trigger the PDF export from within the CRM rather than manually creating a PDF in a text editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Export to PDF' or 'Print' workflow within the Quote record.

integrity.description: The agent should use merge fields in the template, not type 'Global Tech Industries' directly into the template body.
integrity.visual_evidence: The template editor showing variable placeholders/tags rather than the final values.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source text is in ~/Documents/Master_Service_Agreement_Template.txt. The template must be named 'MSA Contract'. The target quote is 'Q-Enterprise Server Deployment'.
